_shared: Rooms that share a picture in the original share one here: 21, 23, 36, 38 and 39 copy 1 (office); 16 and 35 copy 2 (hall); 10 and 12 copy 5 (waiting room); 9, 11 and 14 copy 6 (elevator shaft); 26-33 copy 8 (maze of ducts); 20 copies 19.

rooms.1: A small, deserted, plain office in one-point perspective: white walls, a green carpet, two fluorescent ceiling lights, a small framed city-skyline print on the far wall, nothing else.
rooms.2: A long office-building hallway in one-point perspective with worn, threadbare lilac carpet, white walls, plain doors on both sides, fluorescent lights receding to a door at the far end.
rooms.3: A cramped 1980s computer lab: banks of crimson mainframe cabinets with tape reels and blinking panels on both sides, a green floor, consoles and keyboards.
rooms.5: An office building's elevator waiting room: closed steel elevator doors on the far wall with a call button beside them, lilac striped wallpaper, a potted plant and a bench on the right, a framed print.
rooms.6: Looking straight up the inside of a dim elevator shaft lined with dark brick, steel cables and guide rails rising into shadow, a faint light far above. No people, no hands, no figures in the image.
rooms.7: Inside a square metal air duct in perspective; ahead, a huge industrial fan spins in a circular housing, its blades a whirling blur, blocking the way.
rooms.8: Inside a square metal air-conditioning duct in perspective; ahead, a large industrial fan sits motionless in its circular housing; a confusing maze of ducts.
rooms.13: A chemical laboratory: a lab sink with a tall tap, glass-fronted cabinets of flasks and bottles on a yellow-green wall, a white bench with a ring stand and a long glass column.
rooms.15: A luxury penthouse lobby in blue tones: a raised landing with steps up to grand double doors, tall windows on the right, recessed ceiling lights, an empty polished floor.
rooms.17: The glass-and-steel wall of a tall office tower seen from very close, high above a city: rows of windows dropping away to a tiny street far below, a bright blue sky to the left.
rooms.18: Floating weightlessly high in an empty, bright blue sky among a few small white clouds, a city skyline far below on the horizon, a dreamlike calm.
rooms.19: A strange dream: an enormous tan leather couch with deep button tufts floating in a soft, hazy dreamlike void of pastel colours.
rooms.22: The paper room: a huge industrial weighing scale with a big dial and needle on the wall, rolls of blank paper on spindles, the whole floor a steel weighing platform on springs, blue machinery.
rooms.24: An office seen from up near the ceiling, looking down: an air-intake grille in the ceiling close by, a desk, filing cabinet and window below, and a strange pink-and-white mist swirling across the floor. No people or figures in the image.
rooms.25: A maze of square metal air-conditioning ducts in perspective, openings branching off left, right, up and ahead into darkness.
rooms.34: A dimly lit basement full of huge printing presses: rollers, gears and paper webs, blue machinery and green control cabinets.
rooms.37: A web-strewn room filled with life-support machinery and cables, where a frail, blindfolded old woman sits in a high-backed chair at the centre of a vast spider-web of tubes, a cloak over her knees.
rooms.40: Limbo: a white stone spiral stairway rising through swirling grey and white clouds, patches of green void beyond.

items.15: A glowing faceted bio-gem, green and gold, radiating light.
items.16: A smooth glowing energy egg, pale and luminous with swirling inner light.

items.23: An open elevator doorway with steel doors slid apart, a dark empty shaft beyond.
items.25: A tall rectangular wall mirror in a simple frame.
items.27: An open square air-duct vent with its grille removed, darkness inside.
items.28: A strange swirling cloud of pink and white mist.
items.31: A mad scientist in a lab coat and round dark goggles, strapped into a harness of four long, segmented steel robotic arms that rise menacingly around him.
items.33: A human-shaped figure made of crackling blue-white electrical lightning arcs, glowing, arms outstretched.
items.34: A stout villainous scientist with four long mechanical tentacle arms, lying stunned and dazed on the floor, tentacles limp.
items.35: A man in a dark green jumpsuit lying unconscious on his back on the floor, a few faint blue sparks fading around him.
items.38: A tall, menacing green reptilian man-lizard with a long tail, wearing a torn white lab coat and purple trousers.
items.49: A small heap of fine sand on the floor.
items.50: A burly villain whose body is partly made of swirling sand, in a green-and-black striped shirt, fists of sand raised.
items.51: A scientist in a white lab coat, asleep curled up on the floor, who has only ONE arm: the left sleeve of the coat is empty and pinned up at the shoulder.
items.52: A villain whose whole body is made of rippling, translucent water, in a humanoid shape.
items.53: A statue of a man carved from clear ice.
items.55: A glass aquarium tank of water with green plants and a few fish, on a stand.
items.56: A large block of clear ice.
items.58: A large executive desk of polished dark wood.
items.60: A framed modern painting of a city skyline at sunset.
items.62: A sinister circus ringmaster in a red tailcoat, white breeches and a tall top hat with a hypnotic spiral on it, one hand raised.
